nguon: 💬 Giao tiếp · Kể chuyện & chuyện phiếm · bài tự soạn
kind: Hội thoại 2 người bạn kể chuyện vui
L: You look happy today. What's going on?
Oh, I have to tell you something funny that happened to me yesterday.
I was waiting for the bus when I saw a guy waving at me.
I thought he was my cousin Hung, so I waved back and shouted his name.
Oh no! And it wasn't him?
Nope. He walked over, looking really confused, and said, “Do I know you?”
Ha ha! What did you do?
I wanted the ground to open up! I just said sorry and hid behind my phone.
Poor you! That's the funniest thing I've heard all week.
Don't laugh! Tell me you've done something like that too.

exq.q: What was Minh doing when the man waved at him?
exq.why: “I was waiting for the bus when I saw a guy waving”.

exq.q: Who did Minh think the man was?
exq.why: “I thought he was my cousin Hung”.

exq.q: What did the man say to Minh?
exq.why: Anh ta hỏi: “Do I know you?”.

exq.q: How does Lan feel about the story?
exq.a: She thinks it is very funny
exq.why: Lan cười và nói “the funniest thing I've heard all week”.
